says: In next/, the tab's key listener routes each press by run.getState().prefix, which lags the key Msgs it already sent, so a fast C-b h then C-b " drops the split: the quote goes to the tile and the prefix stays armed.
proof: Ticket 1042's fabsh shots step, headless Chromium at 1440x900: after C-b h, an immediate C-b " left two tiles, and the polite region read 'prefix'; with a 1 s pause after C-b h the same keys opened fabsh, t3. Same for C-b l then C-b ".
cost: A person who types tmux keys quickly loses a split with no word on screen, and a visual suite that presses keys without pauses fails.
